data.body: Verification note: full make verify PYTEST_WORKERS=2 completed lint/typecheck and most of the test suite, then hit an existing xdist-sensitive failure in tests/unit/test_mcp_entrypoint_provisioning.py::test_a_peer_finishing_the_clone_while_we_wait_skips_the_redundant_reclone (asserted missing 'was re-cloned by another container'). The failed test passed immediately in isolation (1 passed in 211.54s), matching prior transient evidence on ticket 7680-85c7-af0d-416f. Created linked follow-up stellar-sane-hawk (b1a3-3e62-f1ff-4748) for that separate flake. Goldeneye-specific targeted tests, lint, typecheck, mechanism ratchet, and guarded runner smoke all pass.
